lemmens.name: Trudo Lemmens
roles: Professor / Scholl Chair, Health Law and Policy, U of T
Ontario MAID Death Review Committee member (spoke personally at AMAD)
Expert witness for AG in Truchon and Lamb
lemmens.quote: Let me be blunt: There are myriad reasons not to introduce MAID for the sole reason of mental illness, and they are clearer than ever. First, it is not constitutionally required. Second, evidence from Canada, Belgium and the Netherlands shows it would create significant additional risks of premature death for many Canadians with mental illness.
lemmens.also: Cites Ontario MDRC case summaries as showing sloppy/minimalistic assessments; urges guardrails + suicide prevention over expansion

amad_2026_report.title: Medical Assistance in Dying and Mental Disorder as the Sole Underlying Medical Condition: A Complex and Challenging Conversation Among Canadians
amad_2026_report.recommendation_1: That the Government of Canada amend the Criminal Code to indefinitely exclude persons whose sole underlying medical condition is a mental illness from eligibility for medical assistance in dying.

dissent.ask: Reject majority; SCC reference on MD-SUMC instead of indefinite exclusion

amad_2026_report.next_owner: Justice Minister Sean Fraser / Carney cabinet — review then decide; current open date still 2027-03-17 absent amendment
